tools.name: search_books
tools.description: Search the whole library: titles, authors and descriptions (Latin transliteration works too), then the books' full text. Returns up to 20 books a page, best match first, each with the passage that matched.

tools.name: list_books
tools.description: Browse published books by subject, author or language, newest, most read or by title. Use list_subjects for subject ids and search_authors for author ids.

tools.name: get_book
tools.description: One book's details: title, author, subject, language, description, a passage of its text, its page address and related books.

tools.name: list_subjects
tools.description: Every subject that has books, with its id and how many books it holds, largest first.

tools.name: search_authors
tools.description: Find authors by name (Armenian, Russian or Latin spelling). Without a query, lists the authors with the most books.

tools.name: get_author
tools.description: One author's biography, life dates, page address and books.

tools.name: list_libraries
tools.description: The directory of libraries in Armenia that ELIB lists: name, city, address, phone, website, opening hours and map position.
